Dear Laurenz,
Following your report about the PLC not being in RUN mode.
We checked the charger and the charger looks healthy with a stable connection.
If you want us to deepdive in this issue, it is important for us to have a specific timestamp, with time and date when the issue occurred.

Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0468514-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2/TN4002937458] PLC not in RUN mode CRM:03289000034
additional_info.body:
Dear Priscilla,
Thank you for your feedback.
We have identified the root cause of the issue:
The PLC switch was not turned on
– it was set to
STOP mode from factory delivery
.
This caused significant delays in troubleshooting and identifying the problem.
Recommendation for Factory:
Please inform the factory to
check the PLC switch status during End-of-Line (EOL) testing
to ensure it is set to
RUN mode
before delivery. This will prevent similar issues in the future.
The issue has been resolved, and the charger is now operating normally.
You may
close this ticket
.
Thank you for your support.
With best regards,
Laurenz Stelzl
